title: Route Model Binding
objectives: Explicit binding (`Route::bind`) aur scoped bindings jaanna
Soft deleted aur missing model behaviour handle karna

sections.heading: Route model binding kya hai?
sections.body: Aksar hum route se id lete hain aur `Product::findOrFail($id)` likhte hain. Route model binding yeh kaam Laravel ko de deta hai: route parameter ka naam aur controller ka variable same ho to model apne aap mil jaata hai. Na mile to 404.
explain: `Product` type-hint se Laravel `products` table mein primary key (id) se record dhundhta hai.
Record na mile to automatically 404 aata hai, `findOrFail` likhne ki zarurat nahi.

sections.heading: Real-world example: Slug se URL
sections.body: SEO ke liye `/products/wireless-mouse` jaise URL chahiye. Route mein `{product:slug}` likho.
explain: `{product:slug}` – sirf is route ke liye `slug` column se dhundo.
`getRouteKeyName()` – is model ke saare bindings ke liye default key badal deta hai.

sections.heading: Explicit binding aur custom logic
sections.body: Agar lookup ka apna logic chahiye (jaise sirf published products), to `AppServiceProvider::boot()` mein `Route::bind` use karo.

callout.text: Pehle implicit binding se kaam chalao. Custom logic zarurat par hi lagao.

sections.heading: Scoped bindings: parent ke andar child
sections.body: `/users/{user}/posts/{post:slug}` mein hum chahte hain ki post usi user ki ho. Child par custom key (`:slug`) dene par Laravel parent ke relationship se query karta hai.
explain: Laravel maan leta hai ki `User` model mein `posts` naam ka relationship hai (parameter ka plural naam).
Isse doosre user ki post us URL se nahi khulti.

sections.heading: Soft deleted aur missing models
sections.body: Soft deleted models by default 404 dete hain. Alag behaviour chahiye to:
explain: `missing()` – model na mile to 404 ki jagah apna response (jaise redirect).

versionDiff.heading: Route model binding: Laravel 11, 12, 13
versionDiff.intro: Implicit binding, `{model:column}` aur `Route::bind` teeno versions mein same kaam karte hain.

items.11: `getRouteKeyName()` aur `{product:slug}` se custom key. `Route::bind` ko `AppServiceProvider::boot()` mein likhte hain.
items.13: Same, aur 13 docs mein `Illuminate\Database\Eloquent\Attributes\RouteKey` attribute bhi dikhta hai (route key set karne ke liye). Exact use ke liye official routing docs dekho.

errors.cause: Us id/slug ka record database mein nahi hai (yeh 404 hi hai).
errors.fix: Record check karo, seed chalao, ya `missing()` se custom response do.

errors.error: Model inject nahi ho raha (string/id mil rahi hai)
errors.cause: Route parameter `{product}` aur controller variable `$item` ka naam alag hai.
Implicit binding soft deleted models ko skip karti hai.

debug.body: Pehle Tinker mein check karo ki record sach mein hai aur key sahi hai.

code.code:
php artisan tinker
>>> App\Models\Product::where('slug', 'wireless-mouse')->first()
php artisan route:list --path=products

tasks: Product model aur table banao (`php artisan make:model Product -m`)
`/products/{product}` route aur controller banao jo `Product $product` inject kare
`slug` column jodo aur route ko `{product:slug}` se badlo
Ek na-maujood slug kholo aur 404 dekho

quiz.q: Implicit binding ke liye kya zaroori hai?
options: Route parameter aur controller variable ka same naam
quiz.why: `{product}` aur `Product $product` ka naam match hona chahiye.

options: Model ko id ki jagah `slug` column se dhundo
quiz.why: Colon ke baad wala column lookup key banta hai.

quiz.q: Model na mile to default kya hota hai?
quiz.why: Implicit binding mein missing model par 404 aata hai.

interview.a: Route parameter ko automatically Eloquent model instance mein badalna, naam match hone par.

interview.q: Default key kaunsi hoti hai aur use kaise badalte hain?
interview.a: Primary key (`id`). `{model:column}` ya model mein `getRouteKeyName()` se badal sakte ho.

interview.q: Implicit aur explicit binding mein farak?
interview.a: Implicit naming convention se chalti hai. Explicit mein `Route::bind` se apna lookup logic likhte hain.
Nested routes mein child model ko parent ke relationship ke andar dhundhna, taaki child usi parent ki ho.

interview.q: Soft deleted model ke saath binding kaise chalate hain?

summary: Naam match karo, model apne aap mil jaayega.
Scoped binding child ko parent se bandhti hai.
`withTrashed()` aur `missing()` se edge cases handle hote hain.
